title: Max and Spirit Week
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for the McKinley Bulldogs.

pages: At the end of the school year, McKinley has Spirit Week. Every day has a different theme, and the whole school dresses up. Max has a calendar on the fridge with all five days circled in blue.
Monday is Pajama Day. Max wears pajamas with tiny bones on them and brings a stuffed turtle to class. Even the principal wears slippers to morning announcements!

Tuesday is Crazy Hair Day. Max asks Grandma for the craziest hair ever. Grandma uses green hair gel and twelve tiny rubber bands, and Max's ears stick straight up like two antennas. Lupe has a braid shaped like a pretzel, and Kai has a real toy dinosaur sitting in his hair.

Wednesday is Twin Day. Max and Kai plan to dress exactly the same, in red shirts and blue shorts. But on Wednesday morning, Max shows up in a blue shirt and red shorts! "We're opposite twins," Kai laughs. "That's even better."

Thursday is Favorite Book Character Day. Max dresses as a turtle from a library book, with a cardboard shell on a backpack. At recess, Max walks very, very slowly, to stay in character, and is the last one to the drinking fountain.

Friday is Blue and Gold Day, the McKinley school colors. Everyone wears blue and gold, and the whole school gathers on the blacktop for a cheer. "Who are we?" shouts a teacher. "BULLDOGS!" everyone shouts back. Max cheers so loudly that Max's voice squeaks.

That night, Max lays the week's outfits on the bed: pajamas, rubber bands, the opposite twin shirt, the cardboard shell, and a blue and gold T-shirt. "Spirit Week was the best week of the year," Max tells Grandma. Grandma smiles. "That's what you said about Halloween." Max thinks about it. "McKinley has a lot of best weeks."

o: Kai forgot it was Twin Day
